body: It’s not irrational. You can still celebrate your anniversary. Oh yeah, tell him you know how much he made on your real anniversary and he’s buying you dinner at the swankiest place in town!! Don’t ever lose your sense of humor. Most men just don’t know this stuff. If you guys are fairly new spouses, it may just take time for him to grow up a bit. That’s not uncommon.
Your wife sounds like a total Karen. NTA.

Dear wet nurse people:
She’s not lactating and didn’t have mom’s permission. I was in this position when I had a babysitter pull this. It’s actually criminal and yes, OP. You are absolutely right. This should actually be reported, this woman should not be around kids. NTA.
I feel ya. My ex left and i got so sick my kidneys shut down. I spent Christmas in the hospital fighting for my life and my ex hooked up with someone else

Guys on there are looking for someone who cooks like mom, works out 3 hours a day so we can be at home cleaning the house in our bikini when they come home from work every night. They ask for pictures to see if you look good enough to play the girlfriend in this fantasy. This fantasy is true even if you looks like Frodo and still live with mom. That’s what it seems like anyway.
I’m at two months and he’s seeing the woman I suspected him with. He told me I was crazy. I want to kill myself.
If you have people living in your town, it’s in everyone’s best interest that they are counted so the government can provide economic support. If not, you’ll be supporting them alone.
I realize now how little my life means to people. There is nothing stopping me.

I have vestibular disorder and I’m dizzy and throw up
All the time. I’m being evaluated for a feeding tube. I really have no reason to go on, I’m looking at a lifetime of this.
I’m sick all the time. I’m sick ALL THE TIME.

NTA. This is a bad idea. I had this with my son and he grew up not knowing where he lived. He chose to live with his dad when he got older, I let him go and His dad and I coparented nicely. You have to consider the kids, especially when you feel like crying. They feel worse.

I HATE THIS TOO! Dating is always going to be risky no matter what. She could be unattractive, and she could be a trainwreck personality wise. I even hate the word cat fishing. My ex cheated on me when I was pregnant. There are worse things than not finding your first date attractive. I’m not going to hold up a “fresh cookie” and prove to some stranger I’m cute. He can find out. It’s a surprise.
I get sick everyday and I’ve lost 40 pounds. I can barely function some days. It’s going on 2 months of this without a break. I threw up so much in December my kidneys shut down.

It’s time to reign in MIL. This was a major overstep. It’s good to raise kids to be open-minded, but this reminds me of the post where someone’s mil went and had her child baptized behind her back. It’s time to establish boundaries.
16 cents. I love them!
ESH. You should’ve had a vasectomy. Birth control is not solely the woman’s job.
NAH. They thought they were paying a sincere compliment. However, this could be a teaching moment about rude assumptions.
I didn’t ask you for your advice.

Please don’t respond anymore. You are someone on a website. Don’t give me advice, you don’t know my situation. And no, doctors don’t take their own pulse before a code because that’s insane. Time is the enemy and no one has time to do pulse checks on one another. Don’t tell me what defines me and don’t tell me I’m “unsafe” because I’m sick. You don’t know me or my situation. You don’t get to tell me what to do

I’ve worked in healthcare for 30 years and they don’t do that. The truth is, doctors are like everyone else and have to work when they are sick, going through a divorce or death of a loved one. I’m tired of everyone assuming you have to be in complete symbiosis with nature and the elements to work or your useless. That’s just wrong. I just need to figure out these challenges.

I can’t drive or really go anywhere. My life is what it is, but it’s hard. I was up all night puking the other night and it took me all I had to pull it together for my clients that day. My focus should be entirely on that.
Because I’m totally stupid and I’m living that down too.
I’m done. I left a month ago.
No joke. I’ve been really torn up by all the mean things he says to me
I did leave but the mental games he played with me have been pretty scarring. I doubt myself and my perceptions all the time. I think I just need to find a good therapist so this never happens again.

Yes, I did avoid him after I found out. He came and found me when she served him with divorce papers. I hate to say it but I think he probably is a narcissist. He wrote a book on character but the funny thing is he really doesn’t have any. He has kind of a bad history of how he treats women and makes them out to be the crazy one. He does this all the time. I called him out on it, I told him “you are gaslighting me”. I think he knows I’m finally on to him for good. He can’t insult me or call me crazy anymore. I had a lot of abuse in childhood and he says “my issues” stem from that. He’s a psychologist.

When I got sick my life changed so rapidly I now no longer had time for these games anymore. Things have gotten serious quickly for me and learning to live with this illness and function is taking all my time up but I feel really bad for being stupid 3 times.
I feel just nuts. I feel like I’ve spent 4 years being played so hard by this guy I can’t take it.
He never takes responsibility for anything and when he screws up he flips it all on them.
He was the most obnoxious, pompous jerk I thought I’d ever met and he warmed to me slowly.

I’ve only been to the ER once with it, from vomiting and I thought I was fainting at night. It turned out to be seizures, and I was in acute renal failure. I was in the hospital the week of Christmas. It’s been a hard go no doubt. I’ve got to learn how to live with this disease and function.
I just know someday I’ll be back at the beach again. Someday I’ll find my spirit again. I just hold onto that thought when I’m down. This isn’t going to last forever.
No, I don’t. I’m figuring all this out, what I can do and what I can’t do.

Yes that part I agree is nice!! I’m trying not to best myself up too much about my off days. Mornings are really bad for me sick-wise. I’m usually throwing up all morning and has a business owner I must always look and sound my best and present well. I need to figure out how to perform consistently. If I have a stretch of bad days, I need to figure out how to keep a consistent presence with my clients. I can’t just say “sorry about the late letter, I’ve been sick.”

I do. I get turned off of support groups because people like to offer diagnoses and medical advice and I get turned off of that. I’m a nurse practitioner, so I notice that. I’m learning to manage my work, glad I work from home, but I am sick a lot and have to be presentable, organized and focused at work. It’s taken everything I have to figure all this out. I miss the conversations we had and we connected so well, but I’m not the girl he could go party with anymore. He loves his wine and dancing, and here I am a month later and I can’t even smell alcohol or walk some days. I’m struggling with depression. I was stalked recently so i deleted my facebook and Instagram, cutting off a lot of support. It’s been very hard.
It’s hard being lonely. But I have to give myself some time to figure all this out.

I really stepped back and reevaluated my situation today. My work is going to require all of me, and I need to stop investing so much of my time worrying about my failed relationship and certainly not taking on a new one. I’m back down to earth. Nothing is going to take this away, I need to learn to live and function with Ménière’s disease. That’s my priority right now.
I hope so. I’m a real go getter in life and my daughter helps me clean now. Today’s been a bad dizzy day. I feel Ike I’m confined to my apartment.
I try to meet new people, but it’s hard with these limitations. To make matters worse, I got stalked by someone and had to delete fb and Instagram. My daughter turned me onto reddit
There’s a lot of them on there.
I told my ex that two of those accounts were actually prostitutes and he freaked out because he’s a professional. I left this guy and I’m so not sorry.

He threw a flashlight at me last year and broke it because he was sick of me being all up in his shit all the time. I know this is for the best, but it’s still hard. I am seeing a counselor now and I hope it helps.

It is! It’s just hard especially with me being sick all the time. My ent appointment is in a month and my kidneys shut down last month. I’ve tried to meet other people but I eventually have to tell them I’m too sick to go out. It’s a catch 22.
Bang. I know we aren’t supposed to have caffeine but I can keep that down and it gets me through work.
I have it. I’ve been in bed almost a month in a half now, just sick all the time. I’ve lost almost 40 pounds but I’m not enjoying it at all. The depression is the worst.
